comparison.objective: Load a card under a clipboard clip and prove that the spring clamp retains it.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sprung lever open with one hand while sliding and aligning a thin sheet with the other, then release and lift the board.
comparison.success_condition: Card clamped at the stop and square, released, and retained during a 60-degree tilt with no more than 3 mm slip.
comparison.reason: Although both use asymmetric bimanual coordination and retention verification, the clipboard tests sustained spring opening plus sheet insertion, not concentric driver-and-wrench counterholding.
